alkylation reagent: the resuspended pellet was alkylated with 15 mm iodoacetamide in 50 mm ammonium bicarbonate
alkylation concentration: the resuspended pellet was alkylated with 15 mm iodoacetamide in 50 mm ammonium bicarbonate
cleavage agent: The sample was digested using either trypsin (catalog #V5111, Promega) or chymotrypsin (catalog #V106A, Promega)
collision energy: The instrument was set at full scan with collision energy of 30 and 19 eV in positive mode.
fractionation method: Mass spectrometry proteomics was performed on a Q Exactive instrument after fractionation on a coupled EASY-nLC 1000 Liquid Chromatography System
instrument: An HPLC ACCELA instrument (equipped with an autosampler and 600 LC pump, Thermo Fisher Scientific) was coupled to a Q Exactive Orbitrap Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization type: Heated electrospray ionization (HESI) was used as the method of ionization by coupling a HESI probe to the Q Exactive instrument.
labeling: Our labeled proteomics (iTRAQ) revealed that these four groups (low-recovery, high-recovery, stay-normal, and control no-injection groups) were compositionally distinct from each other
reduction reagent: reduced with 6 m urea and 10 mm dithiothreitol in 50 mm ammonium bicarbonate for 1 h at room temperature
reduction concentration: reduced with 6 m urea and 10 mm dithiothreitol in 50 mm ammonium bicarbonate for 1 h at room temperature
